key_reasoning.reason: The change spans two independent feature workflows — the chat prompt LLM selector (ChatPromptLlmSelector.tsx, with project-default fetch/race-guard effects against chatsStore and projectsStore) and the assistant form (AssistantForm.tsx seeding llm_model_type via the new resolveInitialLlmModelType util). Two components across two product areas with a shared concept (project default LLM resolution) but no shared code between them.

ChatPromptLlmSelector.tsx introduces an async fetch-with-cancellation-guard pattern (cancelled flag) to avoid a stale/racy project-default effect overwriting state from a switched-away project — a correctness-sensitive but well-established React pattern, not novel; resolveInitialLlmModelType.ts is a small, clearly-scoped pure function with direct unit coverage.

6 unique files touched: 2 modified (ChatPromptLlmSelector.tsx, AssistantForm.tsx) and 4 new (resolveInitialLlmModelType.ts + its test, 2 new ChatPromptLlmSelector test files), spread across 5 directories under two top-level pages areas (chat/components/ChatPrompt and assistants/components/AssistantForm + assistants/utils).
